description:
Deposit ONE credential into your encrypted, account-scoped vault and get back an
    opaque credential id (cred_id) to hand to the cloud_* / cloudflare_* / origin_cert_setup
    tools instead of a token, a file path, or an inline private key. ctype is one of:
    cf_token, scw_key, hcloud_token, origin_key, origin_cert. Provide the secret via `value`
    (encrypted at rest immediately; it never travels again) or `value_file` (a path on THIS
    host, confined to the deploy-keys dir on the gateway). Returns {cred_id, ctype, last4} -
    never the secret. For the strongest privacy on the gateway, POST it to /vault out-of-band
    so it never enters the agent transcript at all.
name: vault_store
